_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. This file is NOT a price list and is NOT loaded: the loader
reads price-snapshot.<region>.json, and EXAMPLE is not an AWS region, so a
deployment that copies this file without editing it still gets a withheld
forecast rather than a made-up one.
To record a real snapshot: open the sourceUrl, read the S3 Standard prices
for YOUR region, copy them here as plain decimal USD strings, set
effectiveAt to the date the price list says they took effect and reviewedAt
to the date YOU read it, and save as price-snapshot.<region>.json.
A snapshot older than 90 days is stale and withholds the forecast, which
blocks new-account and public enablement — never an in-flight deletion.
